rationale: The two leading confirmation variants were not distinguishable at this precision. Select native forest inference plus exact heads-up river enumeration for timing margin. It also preserved self-field points more closely than the rollout variant. Keep ICM and adaptation, widen openings by 15%, and use the 7 BB non-Nash open-shove threshold. The constrained heads-up shove/fold policy remains available as an option, but full-game confirmation favored disabling it in the default policy.
limitations: These are synthetic-field development comparisons with multiple candidates and unadjusted intervals. They are selection evidence, not a held-out improvement guarantee or proof of optimality. No held-out tournament or equity audit has yet been read.
